Companion Animal Travel Desk training page: handling the documented workflow matters because families and their pets deserve consistent guidance from check-in through arrival. As a new staff member at Aurelia Skyways, you will support travelers with clear steps, calm communication, and careful recordkeeping that protects both companion animals and the people responsible for them.

Your day begins with understanding what we track in the system and why. The senior coordinator sets daily service direction, and your work feeds accurate information into the desk’s records. When a traveler like Talia Chaudhary brings a pet such as Willow, your role is to confirm that every required item is present, then route the case to the correct oversight path. When you maintain this discipline, you reduce delays and prevent the wrong information from following the wrong traveler.

First, verify the arrival paperwork for the entity "arrival pickup" and ensure the correct value "FM-394". This form is the required document that we use to authorize and document the arrival pickup workflow in our records.

Next, confirm which staff role oversees the transfer decisions. The entity "transfer" is overseen by the value "Records Curator", meaning the specific staff role that reviews and manages the case records.

Finally, watch the time boundary for processing so the traveler can receive timely guidance. For the entity "booking", the value "84 hours" defines the deadline for completing the booking process steps in the desk workflow.

During interactions, speak plainly and confirm key details in a calm, respectful tone. When a traveler is anxious, prioritize clarity: state what you can do now, what you will do next, and when they can expect follow-up. If you encounter missing or unclear information, stop and escalate to the appropriate point in the process instead of improvising. Record all actions promptly and keep notes factual, focusing on what was verified, what was requested, and what was routed for oversight.

Remember: follow each documented step in order, verify the right records, and escalate issues without delay.
